name: ai.withone/mcp
title: One
description: Search, document and execute authenticated API calls across 500+ apps via one MCP server

environmentVariables.name: ONE_PERMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Restrict actions by HTTP method: read (GET), write (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH) or admin (all)

environmentVariables.name: ONE_CONNECTION_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated connection keys the agent may see, or * for all

environmentVariables.name: ONE_ACTION_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated action IDs the agent may see and run, or * for all

environmentVariables.name: ONE_KNOWLEDGE_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Set true to drop execute_one_action and run in knowledge-only mode

environmentVariables.name: ONE_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Scope connections to a single user, team, organization or project identifier

environmentVariables.name: ONE_IDENTITY_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Type of ONE_IDENTITY: user, team, organization or project
